mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the mean return in low-unemployment periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.4 million units signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1400.0, or the average return in high-housing-start periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signal a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market contraction, indicating an impending recession that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 104.0 and UNRATE > 3.4%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that inflation expectations are unanchored, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 298.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 4.5%, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 680 billion dollars signals strong underlying consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 55% of instances, or the average return in high-RSAFS periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll employment above 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market momentum, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 153000.0, or the mean return in high-payroll periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP growth above 2.0% annualized, combined with rising housing starts, signals a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 > 20050.0 and HOUST > 1400.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).
